summary.zh: 站内搜索、热榜、直答与知识库
summary.en: Search, hot lists, answers, and knowledge bases

description.zh: 接入知乎开放平台，支持站内与全网搜索、热榜、直答，以及知识库检索、PDF 解析和 PPT 生成等异步任务。需要在插件配置中填写 access_secret。
description.en: Connects to the Zhihu Open Platform for on-site and web search, hot lists, synthesized answers, knowledge-base retrieval, PDF parsing, and PPT generation. Requires an access_secret in the plugin settings.

highlights.zh: 知识库检索与文档任务

summary.zh: 登录后浏览推荐、搜索、互动与发布

description.zh: 通过应用内 WebView 登录小红书，浏览推荐流与搜索、查看主页和笔记、评论互动、查看通知，并发布图文或视频。无需 MCP 服务器或中转地址。
description.en: Signs in through an in-app WebView to browse feeds and search, view profiles and notes, comment and interact, read notifications, and publish image or video posts. No MCP server or relay required.

highlights.zh: 评论互动与图文/视频发布

summary.zh: 搜索、播放、歌单和音乐库
summary.en: Search, playback, playlists, and your library

description.zh: 搜索歌曲、艺人、专辑和歌单，控制播放与音量，管理音乐库和播放队列。需要在插件配置中填写 Spotify Client ID 与 Client Secret，并在应用内完成授权。
description.en: Search tracks, artists, albums, and playlists; control playback and volume; manage your library and queue. Requires a Spotify Client ID and Client Secret plus in-app authorization.

summary.zh: 节点、主题、回复、通知与账号信息
summary.en: Nodes, topics, replies, notifications, and account info

description.zh: 浏览 V2EX 节点、主题与回复，查看通知和账号信息。需要在插件配置中填写 Personal Access Token。
description.en: Browses V2EX nodes, topics, and replies, and shows notifications and account information. Requires a Personal Access Token in the plugin settings.

summary.zh: 热搜、智搜、超话与账号微博
summary.en: Trending, AI search, Super Topics, and posts

description.zh: 查看微博热搜与智搜摘要，浏览超话，读取授权账号的微博，并支持发帖、评论与回复。需要配置 App ID 与 App Secret。
description.en: Shows Weibo trending searches and AI summaries, browses Super Topics, reads the authorized account's posts, and supports posting, comments, and replies. Requires an App ID and App Secret.
